featured_reviews.name: Pratheek Sehgal
featured_reviews.review_text:
As parents, finding a safe, comfortable, and reliable place for our daughter in Mumbai was our top priority when she secured admission at St. Xavier’s College last year. Naturally, we were quite worried about her stay and overall safety.

On the admission day, we received a list of nearby accommodations from the college administration. After calling a few options, we connected with Mr. Alok Gupta regarding RamNam Mansion (only girls PG behind Metro Cinema, Marine Lines). He immediately invited us to visit and personally showed us all available options.

We were truly impressed from the first visit itself. The PG is:
•	At walking distance from the college
•	Very clean and well-maintained
•	Equipped with all essential facilities a student needs

Even after exploring and comparing with other PGs nearby, RamNam Mansion clearly stood out. We finalized and booked it the very same day and also had the opportunity to meet the owner, which gave us additional confidence and peace of mind.

What makes this place special:
•	Supportive Management: Mr. Alok Gupta is extremely helpful, genuine, and always just a call away for any issue
•	Homely Environment: Special mention to Keshar Mausi and the staff for their excellent housekeeping, cleanliness, and delicious home-like food.
•	Safety & Security: Round-the-clock presence of Mishra ji (watchman)

Over the past year, both we and our daughter have felt that this PG is truly like a second home for her.

We highly recommend RamNam Mansion to all PG/UG students, especially girls looking for a safe and comfortable stay near St. Xavier’s or nearby colleges. Absolutely worth considering!

featured_reviews.name: Shivangi Deshmukh
featured_reviews.review_text:
I stayed at Ram Nam Mansion for around 11 months, and overall it was a good experience. The rooms are well-maintained, and the place feels safe and comfortable for long-term stays. The environment is peaceful, which made it easy to focus on work and daily routines.
The management is generally supportive and responsive whenever there are issues. Basic amenities are provided, and cleanliness is maintained regularly. Like any PG, there are a few minor areas where things could improve, but nothing that seriously affected my stay.
I would recommend Ram Nam Mansion to students and working professionals looking for a decent and reliable PG for an extended stay.

featured_reviews.name: Pari Sehgal
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a really great experience staying at this PG. It’s very conveniently located near the college, which made daily commuting easy.
The househelp came in every day, so the place was always clean and well-maintained. What stood out the most was how responsive and helpful the brothers ( Alok and Amber) were. Whether it was an issue with the geyser, toaster, laundry baskets, or anything else, they were always quick to resolve it.
Overall, it was a very comfortable and hassle-free stay, and I would definitely recommend it to others looking for a well-managed PG.

featured_reviews.name: Rhea Jimmy
featured_reviews.review_text: Such a pleasant stay at Ram Nam this year. It's easily one of the best, most well-maintained PGs near St.Xavier’s College. Both the night and day watchmen are super sweet, kind, and caring. They actually look out for you and keep an eye out to make sure everything is alright. Alok, our broker, was also super helpful throughout the stay, from showing us the best flat to make sure things keep fixed and maintained in a timely manner. The cherry on top of the cake really is Kesar Maushi. She stayed with us throughout the year and has cared for us like we were her kids. She made great food always and also cared for us every time any of us fell sick. She's one of the main reasons why everything went so smoothly. Overall, it's a great place to stay and super amazing locality, of course.

featured_reviews.name: Mukta Puntambekar
featured_reviews.review_text: My daughter stayed here for 11 months while doing PG Diploma at XIC and had a very nice experience. The place is safe and well-managed. Mishra ji, the guard ensures good security. Keshar Maushi, the cook, was very helpful and caring. Alok and Amber were always quick to resolve any issues. Overall, a comfortable and reassuring stay.

featured_reviews.name: Nimisha Gupta
featured_reviews.review_text: Ram Nam Stay truly felt like a home away from home. It’s within walking distance of Xaviers, so commuting is never a concern. Kesar Maushi, who cooks delicious homely meals. Both the guard uncles are also super supportive and ensure our safety around the clock. The accommodation is well-equipped with all essential amenities, and our broker Mr. Alok and owner Mr. Hitesh ensured that any issues, whether it’s Wi-Fi or minor leakages, are resolved within a day. It’s genuinely hard to find a place like this to live!🫶🏻

featured_reviews.name: Kashish milani
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had a wonderful stay here. The location is unbeatable for South Bombay college students, with CSMT, Churchgate, and the aqua line metro all close by, making commuting on any line so easy.
But what truly made it special was Kesar Maushi. She is incredible, from making sure no one ever slept hungry to keeping the entire place perfectly maintained, she genuinely took care of us like her own kids. If you’re looking for a place that feels safe and homely, this is it!

featured_reviews.name: Vedansha
featured_reviews.review_text: Ram Nam mansion is the ideal place to stay in Marine Lines. Everything is within walking distance, especially if you’re in Xavier’s. I stayed here for a year and it became our home until the end of my stay due to the excellent facilities and the friendly people we met here. It was one of the best decisions I made after planning to study in Mumbai.
